entries.title: MorphoStain: Physics-Guided Latent Diffusion and Morphological Distillation for Multiplex Stain Decomposition in Alzheimer's Neuropathology
entries.scope_rationale: Conditional latent diffusion teacher and distilled FastStudent U-Net decompose multiplex Alzheimer neuropathology stains.

entries.title: Large language models recover archival pathology data and identify NSE as a candidate prognostic marker in Ewing sarcoma
entries.scope_rationale: OpenAI o3 extracts IHC and histological variables from archival Ewing sarcoma pathology reports with expert-validated accuracy.

entries.title: Integrating Histopathology Foundation Models and PRAME Immunohistochemistry in Melanoma Diagnosis
entries.scope_rationale: Virchow2 and STAMP neural WSI models predict melanoma and morphological features integrated with PRAME IHC.

entries.title: Evaluating the ability of spatial transcriptomics foundation models to learn multi-scale spatial variation
entries.scope_rationale: Matryoshka sparse autoencoder interprets and benchmarks spatial transcriptomics foundation-model embeddings.

entries.title: Integrating Unsupervised Clustering with Transformer-Based Models for De Novo Cell Population Identification
entries.scope_rationale: Fine-tuned Geneformer Transformer plus probability-matrix clustering identifies colorectal cell populations.

entries.title: Deep learning design and in vivo validation of Müller glia-specific cis-regulatory elements
entries.scope_rationale: Species-specific deep models trained on single-cell ATAC predict cell-type chromatin accessibility and design retinal regulatory elements.

entries.title: A Biologically Interpretable Single-Cell Pathology Foundation Model for Molecular Decoding of H&E Images
entries.scope_rationale: Loki2 single-cell pathology foundation model is trained on UniSeg cells and evaluated on molecular decoding, retrieval and in-silico protein staining.

entries.title: Large language models complement established workflows for mechanistic model construction and refinement in systems biology
entries.scope_rationale: LLM multi-agent workflow constructs and refines models of cell-cell communication across five immune cell types.

entries.title: scPACE: A Personalized Autoencoder for Cell Evolution in Single-Cell Transcriptomics
entries.scope_rationale: Hierarchical personalized variational autoencoder models cell/donor states and missing cell types.

entries.title: Learning gene co-regulation across cells with Multicellular Transformer
entries.scope_rationale: Multicellular Transformer foundation model learns cross-cell gene context, signaling and perturbation responses from scRNA.

entries.title: Elflow: Automated Quality Control and Self-Supervised Representation Learning for High-Dimensional Cytometry
entries.scope_rationale: VICReg self-supervised deep representations support cytometry phenotyping, leukemia diagnosis and patient aggregation.

entries.title: Where single-cell foundation models help: a public-data benchmark of annotation, in silico perturbation and gene regulatory inference
entries.scope_rationale: Public-data benchmark directly evaluates scGPT, Geneformer, Nicheformer, scFoundation and neural perturbation predictors.
